test_cases.description: Verifies that GiteaPlatform exposes a class attribute forge_type equal to the string 'gitea'.
preconditions: afissues package is installed with afissues/gitea.py present
afissues._ssrf._validate_url is importable and does not raise for the test URL
test_cases.input: Access GiteaPlatform.forge_type class attribute directly without instantiation
test_cases.expected: GiteaPlatform.forge_type == 'gitea'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: assert GiteaPlatform.forge_type == 'gitea'

test_cases.description: Verifies that the constructor sets the API base URL to https://{url}/api/v1, stores owner and repo, and builds auth headers with the token scheme.
preconditions: afissues._ssrf._validate_url is mocked to return None (no SSRF rejection)
afissues._http is available and mocked for HTTP client construction
test_cases.expected: Instance base_url == 'https://gitea.example.com/api/v1'; auth headers contain {'Authorization': 'token mytoken'}; owner == 'myorg'; repo == 'myrepo'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with mock(_validate_url, returns=None):
  platform = GiteaPlatform('myorg', 'myrepo', 'mytoken', 'gitea.example.com')
  assert platform.base_url == 'https://gitea.example.com/api/v1'
  assert platform.auth_headers['Authorization'] == 'token mytoken'
  assert platform.owner == 'myorg'
  assert platform.repo == 'myrepo'

  assert mock_validate.call_count == 1
  assert mock_validate.called_with('gitea.example.com')

test_cases.description: Verifies that _resolve_label_id raises IntegrationError with a descriptive message when the label is not found after a full API fetch.
preconditions: GiteaPlatform instance is created with _validate_url mocked
HTTP GET to labels endpoint returns 200 with [{'id': 7, 'name': 'bug'}]
Label 'nonexistent' is not in the response
test_cases.expected: IntegrationError is raised with a message indicating the label does not exist
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:

  with assert_raises(IntegrationError) as exc:
    await platform._resolve_label_id('nonexistent')
  assert 'nonexistent' in str(exc)

test_cases.description: Verifies that subsequent calls to _resolve_label_id for a known-missing label raise IntegrationError immediately without making another HTTP request.
preconditions: GiteaPlatform instance is created with _validate_url mocked
First call to _resolve_label_id('nonexistent') has already fetched from API and found the label absent
Cache is marked as fully populated
test_cases.expected: IntegrationError is raised immediately; no additional HTTP GET is made to the labels endpoint
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
# First call populates cache (label not found)
with mock_http_get('/api/v1/repos/myorg/myrepo/labels', 200, [{"id": 7, "name": "bug"}]) as mock_get:
  with assert_raises(IntegrationError):
    await platform._resolve_label_id('nonexistent')
  call_count_after_first = mock_get.call_count
  with assert_raises(IntegrationError):
    await platform._resolve_label_id('nonexistent')
  assert mock_get.call_count == call_count_after_first  # no extra call

property_tests.description: For any sequence of _resolve_label_id and create_label calls, the label ID cache only grows monotonically and never contains entries not derived from API responses or successful create_label calls.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random sequences of (action, label_name) pairs where action is one of: resolve_existing, resolve_missing, create_new; mock API responses consistently
property_tests.invariant_check: After each operation, assert that every key in _label_cache maps to a value that was either returned by the labels GET endpoint or by a create_label POST response; assert cache only grows (entries are never removed mid-session); assert a second resolve for a missing label does not trigger an additional HTTP GET

property_tests.description: For any call to assign_label, remove_label, or create_issue with labels, _resolve_label_id is always called before any HTTP request using a label identifier, ensuring only numeric IDs appear in request bodies/URLs.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary label names (strings of varying length and content); mock _resolve_label_id to return a predictable numeric ID; capture all HTTP requests made
property_tests.invariant_check: Assert that _resolve_label_id is called before any POST/DELETE to label endpoints; assert that the label name string never appears as a value in the labels array or URL path of any HTTP request; assert only numeric IDs are used

property_tests.description: For any IntegrationError raised due to a non-success HTTP response, the embedded response text portion of the error message never exceeds 500 characters.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate error response bodies of random length between 1 and 2000 characters for each method that can raise IntegrationError; trigger the error path for each method
property_tests.invariant_check: For each method, when HTTP response is non-success with a body of length N: extract the response text portion from the IntegrationError message; assert len(response_text_in_message) <= 500 regardless of N

property_tests.description: For any call to list_issues_by_label or search_issues, the type=issues query parameter is always present in the outgoing GET request.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary values for label, state, sort, direction, and title_prefix parameters; call list_issues_by_label and search_issues with these values; mock HTTP GET to return 200 with []
property_tests.invariant_check: Capture the query parameters of each GET request; assert 'type' in params and params['type'] == 'issues' for every invocation regardless of input parameter values

property_tests.description: GiteaPlatform method signatures have default parameter values that exactly match PlatformProtocol.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Inspect GiteaPlatform method signatures using Python introspection (inspect.signature)
property_tests.invariant_check: assert inspect.signature(GiteaPlatform.list_issues_by_label).parameters['state'].default == 'open'; assert .parameters['sort'].default == 'created'; assert .parameters['direction'].default == 'asc'; assert inspect.signature(GiteaPlatform.close_issue).parameters['comment'].default is None; assert inspect.signature(GiteaPlatform.create_label).parameters['description'].default == ''

property_tests.description: ConfigError raised by _validate_url always propagates unchanged from the GiteaPlatform constructor without being caught or re-wrapped.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate various ConfigError messages and have _validate_url raise them; attempt GiteaPlatform construction
property_tests.invariant_check: For each raised ConfigError: assert that the exception type caught at the call site is exactly ConfigError; assert it is not IntegrationError or any other type; assert the original error message is preserved unchanged in the propagated exception

property_tests.description: For any call to close_issue with comment=None, exactly one HTTP request is made (PATCH state=closed) and zero requests are made to the comments endpoint.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary issue_number values; call close_issue(issue_number, comment=None) with HTTP mocked
property_tests.invariant_check: Assert that the total number of HTTP calls equals exactly 1; assert that the single call is PATCH to /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}; assert no POST to /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments is made; this loop terminates after exactly 1 iteration
